stories.title: Trump hosts awards party for tech billionaires, almost as if he doesn’t care about ordinary Americans
stories.summary: President Donald Trump hosted an awards ceremony celebrating technology billionaires while the United States faced a cost-of-living crisis and the midterm elections approached. The Guardian’s commentary argues that the event reinforced criticism that Trump is out of touch and neglecting the economic difficulties facing ordinary voters.

stories.title: ‘This is not an anti-tech town’: backlash to datacenter in city once home to IBM
stories.summary: Residents of East Fishkill, New York, are pushing back against a proposed data centre as communities weigh the claimed benefits of AI infrastructure against its costs. Opponents say the dispute is not rooted in hostility to technology, noting that the town once hosted a 460-acre IBM campus where semiconductor research and manufacturing continued for nearly 50 years.

links.headline: ‘This is not an anti-tech town’: backlash to datacenter in city once home to IBM
links.excerpt: Fight in East Fishkill, New York, part of a growing divide over whether AI benefits outweigh enormous downsides For decades, East Fishkill helped build New York’s tech industry.
